title: Edition zero: before the open
summary: Drafted from Friday's closes. Enter Monday at the open, half-size in TSMC, Nvidia and Korea until TSMC reports on Thursday. Superseded on 12 Oct by decisions D-005 and D-006: full-size entry, see the plan update.

title: Plan update: full-size entry, IREN, linker sleeve
summary: Everything is bought in full at Monday's open (D-006). IREN replaces Itau at 4% (D-005), EWZ is 6%, the Brazil reserve 5%, and the defensive sleeve is an 8% index-linked gilt fund. Severe-shock loss 19.24% against the 18% limit, accepted by the owner.
